purpose: Teach: 補う/それでいて/ひっそり/おおよそ/あとがき/困惑/カラダ/集い

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの足りない分は、お父さんが補うわよ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather's quiet strength — your dad will make up what's missing in his own way.
lines.style: Warm, knowing tone. A soft pause before 'will make up.' Speaking from years of observing both men. Gentle reassurance without needing to spell it out.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんは寡黙でいて、それでいて優しいよね
lines.en: Mom, Dad's quiet like that, but… he's kind, isn't he?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost uncertain. Sho testing an observation aloud, checking if what he sees matches what others see. Soft, genuine curiosity in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋でひっそり遊んでね
lines.en: Sho, play in your room quietly for a while, okay?
lines.style: Gentle direction, no edge. A request more than an order. She's giving him space, but warmly. Slight fadeout on the final word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの宿題、おおよそ終わったよ
lines.en: Mom, I finished most of my homework.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Not seeking loud praise — just stating a fact he's pleased about. Small, genuine satisfaction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本のあとがき、読んだ?
lines.en: Mom, did you read the afterword in that picture book?
lines.style: Curious, reaching slightly. Yumiko asking because she genuinely wants to know what Sho thinks. Not interrogating — inviting conversation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達の話に困惑しちゃった
lines.en: Mom, I got confused by what my friend was saying.
lines.style: Dry, small-wry tone — almost self-aware about being confused. Sho reporting the fact with a hint of self-directed humor. Not wounded, just noting it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、カラダを大事にね
lines.en: Mom, take care of yourself, okay?
lines.style: Tender, earnest. Sho reversing care onto his mother the way he's been cared for. Quiet conviction beneath the gentle words. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんちで親戚の集いがあるよ
lines.en: Mom, there's going to be a family gathering at Grandpa's house.
lines.style: Eager, animated — brightening at the thought. Sho sharing news that excites him. Close, wanting her to be as pleased as he is.
